text: I naturally notice when systems, processes, or situations aren't working as well as they could be.
I spend a lot of time pondering how we can improve our current environment or workflows.
I enjoy stepping back to ask big-picture questions about why we do things a certain way.
I often find myself contemplating the untapped potential of a project before it even starts.
I am comfortable sitting with unresolved problems and observing them rather than rushing to fix them immediately.
I love coming up with completely new solutions to complex, unsolved problems.
Brainstorming from scratch is my favorite part of any new project.
I easily generate original ideas and novel concepts when faced with a roadblock.
I prefer creating something entirely new over following a step-by-step instruction manual.
I find joy in designing concepts or workflows that haven't been tried before.
I have a strong intuition for whether a new idea will actually work in the real world.
People frequently ask me to review their plans to find the hidden flaws or refine the details.
I can quickly evaluate multiple options, spot patterns, and identify the best path forward.
I enjoy refining and tweaking someone else's idea to make it significantly better.
I rely heavily on my gut instinct and pattern recognition when making decisions on new proposals.
I get energized by organizing people and getting them excited about a shared goal.
I naturally take charge to get a project off the ground and assign initial tasks.
I enjoy recruiting and persuading others to join in on a new initiative.
I am comfortable pushing people out of their comfort zones to rally them around a vision.
I love building momentum and instilling a sense of urgency in a team.
I find immense joy in helping others bring their ideas and projects to life.
I am quick to volunteer my support and time when someone needs help executing a plan.
I thrive in a supportive role, adapting to exactly what the team needs to succeed.
I anticipate what my team members need and provide it before they even have to ask.
I get satisfaction from answering the call for help on projects championed by others.
I get a deep sense of satisfaction from crossing tasks off a list and finishing a project.
I have no problem pushing through tedious or repetitive work to hit a deadline.
I am driven by seeing tangible results and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
I hate leaving things unfinished and will push hard to get a project across the finish line.
I pride myself on execution, reliability, and overcoming obstacles to complete a task.
